subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: For a structurally valid update that intentionally replaces every instruction line, should Skill Workshop force pending confirmation, reject the update, or continue automatically with rollback recovery?
rationale: The recent automatic-approval default is intentional, while this PR would introduce a new fail-closed update contract; choosing the permanent safety and compatibility behavior requires ownership intent.

options.title: Force destructive updates to pending review
options.body: Use canonical format validation, then require a bounded diff confirmation when an update has no meaningful retained content.

options.title: Reject complete rewrites
options.body: Keep zero-overlap updates invalid and document that users must manually replace or rename the existing skill.

options.title: Allow automatic rewrites with recovery
options.body: Permit structurally valid complete rewrites while adding a first-class restore action and clear rollback output.

recommendation.title: Force destructive updates to pending review
recommendation.body: Use canonical format validation, then require a bounded diff confirmation when an update has no meaningful retained content.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged automatic-approval change defines the adjacent policy this destructive-write safeguard must preserve or intentionally narrow.
